workflows.name: Bin reach
workflows.instruction: Move the gripper above the amber marker.

workflows.name: Pick & place
workflows.instruction: Approach, close the gripper, then move a cube to the bin.

workflows.name: Part sorting
workflows.instruction: Move a part from the workcell into its designated lane.

workflows.name: Safe handoff
workflows.instruction: Bring an object to a handoff pose and wait for release.

models.name: ACT
models.use: Fast, task-specific imitation baseline for a fixed workcell.

models.name: SmolVLA
models.use: Fine-tunable open vision-language-action policy for camera-guided SO-101-style manipulation.

models.name: π₀ / π₀.₅
models.use: Generalist VLA reference for long-horizon, diverse robot control research.

datasets.name: RoboCasa / LIBERO
